Hanji Name
林靜竹教授

Birth Year
1935

Taichung, Taiwan

First year / First city / State in U.S.
1969/-/NY

Address
CA

Family
1. Wife: Jane Shwu-Ching Hahn (韓淑清)

2. Daughter: Juliet Lin

3. Son: Jim Lin, John Lin

Degree and major

Employment
Company Name
Year – Year
Position or title

1. National Taiwan Univ. College of Medicine

1966-1972

Instructor of Obstetrics and Gynecology; Lecturer

2. Univ. of Chicago, OB-GYN Dept.

1976-2001

Professor and Director of high-risk obstetrics clinic

3. Univ. of Chicago

2001

Lifetime Honorary Professor

Accomplishment
1. Professor Emeritus for Life, the Univ. of Chicago 2001-present

2. President of North American Taiwanese Professors’ Association (NATPA) (北美洲台灣人教授協會總會長) 1990

3. North American Taiwanese Medical Association (NATMA) (北美洲台灣人醫師協會理事及教育委員會主席) 1994-1989

4. The first Taiwan American as an American fetal medicine expert (第一位榮獲美國胎兒醫學專家的台美人) 1979

5. Published 2 English textbooks in Specialty of Fetal Medicine, 5 Hanji books and many articles in T. A. newspapers, newsletters, and magazines.

6. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 08/2018

Publication(Non-professional)
1. 「留美夢台灣情」林靜竹文集 2005

2. 「台美生涯七十年」林靜竹傳記 2006

3. 「見證胎兒醫學」 2010

Hobby
Travel, photography, writing, reading, church activities

Notable Accomplishments

Professor Emeritus for Life, the Univ. of Chicago, 2001-present

President of North American Taiwanese Professors' Association (NATPA), 1990

Board Member and Chair of Education Committee, North American Taiwanese Medical Association (NATMA), 1994

First Taiwanese American to be recognized as an American fetal medicine expert (第一位榮獲美國胎兒醫學專家的台美人), 1979

Published 2 English textbooks in the specialty of fetal medicine, 5 Chinese-language books, and many articles in Taiwanese American newspapers, newsletters, and magazines

Outstanding Taiwanese American, elected by Taiwanese American Archives, August 2018

Publications: 「留美夢台灣情」林靜竹文集 (2005); 「台美生涯七十年」林靜竹傳記 (2006); 「見證胎兒醫學」(2010)
